title: Letter & Report On General D.L. Khorvat

page_data.en:
S.B. D.3070
REGISTRY
D. 3070
12. 1. 32.

January 12, 32.

Sir,

"General D. L. Khorvat".

In reply to your letter, No. 9 dated January 7, 1932, on the subject of the above named, I have the honour to inform you that enquiries made have failed to elicit information regarding this man's presence in Shanghai. The address, 172 Range Road, given by him when in Sourabaya, Java, as his place of residence in Shanghai was occupied from 1926 to October 1930 by the Russian Military Invalids Club and only invalids resided there at the time. The name of the individual in question is not known to either any of the former residents of the Club or the local Union of Russian Army and Navy Men. It would, therefore, seem that Khorvat is masquerading under the name of General Horvath, Chief of the Russian Emigrants in China, who is still in Peking.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

S.B. D.3070
登记处
D. 3070
1932年1月12日

1932年1月12日

先生：

“D. L. 霍尔瓦特将军”。

就上述人士一事，复贵方1932年1月7日第9号来函，谨此奉告，经查询，未能查得此人在上海之踪迹。该人于爪哇岛泗水（Sourabaya）时，曾提供上海兰路（Range Road）172号为其在沪住址；该址自1926年至1930年10月期间，由俄国伤残军人俱乐部占用，当时居住者均为伤残军人。无论是该俱乐部的前住户，还是当地俄国陆海军人员联合会，均不知晓此人之姓名。因此，霍尔瓦特似乎是在冒充仍居北平的中国俄侨首领霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）。

谨此致意，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

副总监
（刑事科）

荷兰驻上海总领事

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 3070 Date 12 / 1 / 32 Station,）
Date January 18, 1932.
Subject (in full) Letter from Netherlands Consulate-General re: General D.L. Khorvat.
Made by I.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by O'Brien D.I.
With reference to the attached letter of January 7,
1932 from the Netherlands Consulate-General regarding one
"General" D.L. Khorvat, diligent inquiries have failed to trace
this individual in Shanghai. The address 179 Range Road, given
by him as being his place of residence in Shanghai, when
registering at a boarding house in Sourabaya, Java, in March
1929, was occupied from 1926 to October 1930, by the "Russian
Military Invalids Club", and the residents during that period
were military invalids. The name "General" D.L. Khorvat is
unknown to both the former residents of the Club and the local
"Union of Russian Army and Navy Men". It appears therefore
that Khorvat is undoubtedly an impostor and is masquerading
under the name of General Horvath, the actual head of the
Russian Emigrants in China, who has been residing in Peking
for the past eleven years.
J. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
O.B. (Brine)
Information. H. Owens
O. i/c Sp. Br.
18/1/32.

日期：1932年1月18日。
事由（全称）：荷兰总领事馆关于 D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军的来信。
制作人：I.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）。转呈人：奥布莱恩（O'Brien），督察长。
关于所附1932年1月7日荷兰总领事馆有关所谓“D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军”的来信，经勤勉查访，未能在上海追踪到此人。此人于1929年3月在爪哇岛泗水一家寄宿公寓登记时，提供的在沪住址为兰路（Range Road）179号；该址自1926年至1930年10月期间，由“俄国伤残军人俱乐部”占用，当时的居住者均为伤残军人。无论是该俱乐部的前住户，还是当地“俄国陆海军人员联合会”，均不知晓“D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军”之名。因此，霍尔瓦特无疑是一名冒名顶替者，正冒充实际上的中国俄侨首领霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath），后者已在北平居住十一年之久。
J. 切列姆尚斯基
特别科警佐

奥布莱恩（Brine）
情报员 H. 欧文斯

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 9.

SHANGHAI, 7th January 1932.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / REGISTRY / D. 3070 / 8. 1. 32.）

（左侧手写批注：No 26045 / in 200m 325 / 8/1-32 N.P.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Russian, calling himself General D.L.Khorvat*, and pretending to be the chief of the Russian emigrants in China, registered in a boarding house at Sourabaya (Netherlands India) in March 1929 and subsequently left without paying his bill. While registering he gave as his address: 172 Range Road, Shanghai.

The actual chief of the Russian emigrants in China however is General Horvath, who, according to information received from the Netherlands Legation at Peping, has not left that city for the last eleven years.

In view of the above I have come to the conclusion that the so-called General D.L.Khorvat must be an imposter, who borrowed the real General Horvath's name.

I shall be greatly obliged if you would kindly cause an investigation to be made regarding the real identity and present whereabouts of this D.L.Khorvat.

For your kind co-operation I tender you my best thanks in advance.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）

Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（右下角手写批注：S2, / For inquiry and / report please. / （签名） / 8.1.32.）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA

第9号

上海，1932年1月7日

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 登记处 / D. 3070 / 1932年1月8日）

（左侧手写批注：No 26045 / in 200m 325 / 1932年1月8日 N.P.）

先生：

谨此奉告，有一名自称 D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军、并伪称是中国俄侨首领的俄国人，于1929年3月在荷属东印度泗水的一家寄宿公寓登记，随后未付账单即离去。登记时，他提供的地址是：上海兰路（Range Road）172号。

然而，中国俄侨的实际首领是霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）。据从荷兰驻北平公使馆获得的消息，他在过去十一年中未曾离开该城。

鉴于上述情况，本人得出结论：所谓的 D.L. 霍尔瓦特将军必是一名冒名顶替者，盗用了真正的霍尔瓦特将军之名。

如蒙贵方对此 D.L. 霍尔瓦特的真实身份及目前下落进行调查，本人将不胜感激。

对于贵方的通力合作，本人预先致以最诚挚的谢意。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

华务秘书

R.C. 阿勒斯（Alers）先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事科与特别科，
上海。

（右下角手写批注：S2, / 请调查并 / 具报。 / （签名） / 1932年1月8日）
